text: Earthquake review | Analyse seismic activity | Review the dashboard earthquake count, magnitudes and locations; distinguish observed data from predictions.
Volcano review | Analyse volcanic activity | Review current volcanic event records and report missing measurements without inventing eruption forecasts.
Cyber review | Prioritise cybersecurity investigation | Inspect known exploited vulnerabilities, CVEs, ransomware and breach counts. Verify source coverage and prioritise exposed systems.
Network review | Review network disruptions | Inspect internet outage and BGP event records and identify information needing verification.
Global summary | Summarise dashboard activity | Summarise risk, earthquakes, volcanoes, cyber incidents, aircraft and maritime counts; label simulated or incomplete sources.
